Weyldran Lyrzek.wikitext:
{{AdeptusMechanicusPortal}}
{{Spoiler|source=Space Hulk: Tactics}}
'''Weyldran Lyrzek''' is the current [[Fabricator General]] of the [[Forge World]] [[Gorgonum]]{{Fn|1a}}
==History==
[[Image:Fabricator General Weyldran Lyrzek.png|thumb|right|190px|[[Fabricator General]] Weyldran Lyrzek{{Fn|1a}}]]
In [[M42]]{{Fn|1b}}, the [[Forge World]] came under threat when the gargantuan [[Space Hulk]], [[Forsaken Doom]] emerged from the [[Warp]]. It was on a collision course with [[Gorgonum]], leading Lyrzek to send out a plea for aid{{Fn|1c}} that was answered by the [[Blood Angels]] [[Space Marine Captain|Captain]] [[Ubaldo]], aboard the [[Battle Barge]] [[Blood Crusader]]{{Fn|1a}}. Lyrzek was grateful for their aid, however due to the losses suffered in their previous campaign, Ubaldo was only able to assemble a single [[Terminator Squad]] for the mission{{Fn|1c}}. Led by [[Terminator Sergeant|Sergeant]] [[Tahariel]], the squadron quickly infiltrated the Space Hulk and began placing a series of [[Melta-bomb]]s near energy cores within the Forsaken Doom{{Fn|1a}}. Though [[Inquisitor]] [[Jost von Marburg]] aided the squadron as well{{Fn|1d}}, the process was slow and [[Fabricator General]] Lyrezk began to panic{{Fn|1e}}. While the Forge World's defense fleet attacked the Space Hulk{{Fn|1f}}, its safety lied within the Blood Angel's hands. Each second carried the Forsaken Doom was closer to Gorgonum and its impact would either destroy the Forge World or infest it with [[Genestealers]]{{Fn|1e}}. Not helping Lyrzek's demeanor, was that Sergeant Tahariel's squadron began undergoing separate missions{{Fn|1g}}, given to them by Inquisitor Marburg{{Fn|1h}} and Captain Ubaldo.{{Fn|1g}} 

This led Lyrzek to contact [[Space Marine Captain|Captain]] [[Ubaldo]] and the [[Terminator Squad]], to remind them of their commitment to save [[Gorgonum]]. He went on to say, that if the [[Forge World]] was destroyed by the [[Forsaken Doom]], then the blame would upon the [[Blood Angels]]. This greatly angered the Captain and he told Lyrzek, that the [[Fabricator General]] would regret any attempt to blackmail this [[Chapter]]. [[Inquisitor]] [[Jost von Marburg|Marburg]] would interject between them and claimed the Blood Angels were following his orders. Marburg would tell Lyrzek that the needs of the [[Ordo Xenos]] had priority first{{Fn|1e}}. When the Forsaken Doom later neared Gorgonum, the Fabricator General asked the Inquisitor if he should begin evacuating what valuable resources he could save. To Lyrek's dismay, Marburg refused to allow an evacuation to take place, for the safety of the [[Imperium]], due to the closeness of the Genestealer infested Space Hulk. Lyrzek opposed this and claimed that Marburg had no authority to stop anyone on the Forge World from trying to escape. The Inquisitor replied that anyone who did so, would violate a direct command from the [[Ordo Xenos]] and he doubted the [[Adeptus Mechanicus]] would dare to do so. Captain Ubaldo would then tell Lyrzek not to fear, as [[Terminator Sergeant|Sergeant]] [[Tahariel]]'s squadron was almost done planting the [[Melta-bomb]]s. Ubaldo then told the Fabricator General to hold his nerves and swore the Blood Angels would prevail{{Fn|1i}}. Shortly afterwards, the [[Terminator]] squadron completed their task and the Forsaken Doom was destroyed. With its destruction, Gorgonum was safe once more.{{Fn|1j}}

When the Tanith First were deployed on [[Caligula (Hive World)|Caligula]], Wheln was part of a detachment assigned to escort a supply convoy from [[Aurelian Hive]] to [[Hive Calphernia]], driving a [[half-track]] with [[Abat]] and [[Brostin]] managing the weapons.{{Fn|1a}}

Later in the [[Siege of Vervunhive]], Wheln was amongst those Tanith deployed to defend the [[Veyveyr Gate]] against the Second [[Ferrozoica|Zoican]] Storm of [[Vervunhive]]. In the course of the fighting, Wheln was shot in the leg by a Zoican soldier.{{Fn|2}}

While the Tanith First were conducting operations on [[Hagia]], [[Colonel]] [[Colm Corbec|Corbec]] was captured by the [[Infardi]] during the retaking of the [[Holy Doctrinopolis]]. Wheln volunteered to accompany [[Sergeant (Imperial Guard)|Sergeant]] [[Gol Kolea|Kolea]] on a rescue mission despite the Tanith being ordered to evacuate the city in preparation for an impending armoured assault on the Doctrinopolis by the [[Eighth Pardus Armoured]].{{Fn|3b}}

Wotan (Cyber-Mastiff).wikitext:
{{NecromundaPortal}}
'''Wotan''' is a [[abominable intelligence|completely mechanical]] [[cyber-mastiff]] that is the loyal hound of the [[Necromunda (planet)|Necromundan]] [[Bounty Hunter]] [[Kal Jericho]].{{Fn|1e}}

==History==
He was originally owned by Jericho's sister [[Merelda]], who served in the [[Inquisitorial Retinue|retinue]] of their mother, the [[Ordo Xenos]] [[Inquisitor]] [[Jena Orechiel]]. The Inquisitor wanted Jericho's help{{Fn|1a}} to destroy a powerful [[Necron]]{{Fn|1b}} [[Setekh (Giant Necron)|weapon]] aboard the [[Space Hulk]] ''[[Kronos (Space Hulk)|Kronos]]''{{Fn|1c}} and so used the [[Adeptus Arbites]] in [[Hive Primus]] to flush the bounty hunter out. While Jericho was able to escape from the Arbites, he was subdued by Wotan on Merelda's orders and soon agreed to aid his mother. The bounty hunter also learned that Merelda was his sister, though she acted coldly to Jericho at first.{{Fn|1a}} Inquisitor Orechiel and her retinue then boarded the space hulk, which contained many other [[Necron]]s which slowly began awakening to their presence. Acting quickly, they located the chamber that held the slumbering Necron weapon known as a [[Setekh (Giant Necron)|Setekh]]. However, they were not the only ones who sought it out, as Inquisitor [[Malva]] and a [[Death Watch]] [[Kill-Team]] arrived for it as well.{{Fn|1c}} 

[[Malva]], though, sought to recover the weapon instead and was aided in this by Orechiel's long-time retinue member [[Vanyan Kloss]], who revealed he had been working for Malva. As the two sides had a standoff{{Fn|1c}}, however, the Setekh awoke and began attacking them. Orechiel stated that the weapon was still not fully charged and ordered her retinue to attack the sarcophagus the Setekh was drawing power from. [[Merelda]] went to do so, but was severely wounded by the traitorous Kloss in order to ensure the weapon was recovered by Malva. The former Arbites was soon attacked by a vengeful Jericho in retaliation and was then killed by the rampaging Setekh.{{Fn|1d}} The inquisitor and her surviving retinue then escaped from the chamber and [[Homing Beacon|teleported]] to Malvo's warship and ordered the destruction of the space hulk. Due to having warmed up to each other during the mission, a recovering Merelda gifted Wotan to Jericho, who returned to his life of bounty hunting on Necromunda with the cyber-mastiff at his side.{{Fn|1e}} 

Recently, Wotan was severely damaged while defending his master after Jericho's wedding to his fellow [[bounty hunter]] and sometimes partner [[Yolanda Catallus]]; he was attacked within [[Hive Primus]]'s [[Hive Spire|spire]]. After the attackers were defeated{{Fn|2}}, Jericho sent Wotan to be repaired by professionals, who allegedly succeeded in doing so. Since his return, the bounty hunter has noticed that the cyber-mastiff will now sometimes suffer from glitches and other odd behaviour.{{Fn|3a}} Unbeknownst to Jericho is that some of this can be attributed to his foe and spymaster [[Nemo]], who the professionals secretly worked for. Under the spymaster's orders they made modifications to Wotan as they repaired him which allow Nemo to see, hear, and record everything that the cyber-mastiff sees. The spymaster can also control Wotan to an extent, though this is limited due to the cyber-mastiff's stubborn [[Machine Spirit]].{{Fn|3b}}

Wrathe.wikitext:
{{WorldEatersPortal}}
[[Image:Wrathe.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Wrathe and his squad on [[Isstvan III]]{{Fn|2}}]]
'''Wrathe''' was a member of the [[World Eaters]] [[Space Marine Legion|Legion]] and a veteran of the [[Great Crusade]], who took part in the [[Horus Heresy]].{{Fn|1a}} 
==History==
When the [[Horus Heresy|Heresy]] began, he was among the [[Legionary|Legionaries]] were marked for death in the [[Battle of Isstvan III]] by their [[Primarchs]], after being deemed to be too loyal to the [[Emperor]]{{Fn|1a}}. Wrathe later died fighting beside the [[Loyalist]] [[World Eaters]], led by [[Space Marine Captain|Captain]] [[Ehrlen]], when they clashed with their [[Primarch]] [[Angron]] and thousands of their traitorous World Eaters Brothers.{{Fn|1b}}
